name: merryn
description: Merryn's generic Claude Code skills for any tenant instance, under one command: /merryn [verb] [project], the project optional (bare /merryn, /merryn loop [project] or /merryn:loop [project] runs the backlog loop; verbs loop, answer [--assist|--auto], status, pause, stop, run, groom, feature), the shared instance, review and docs contracts, and a SessionStart hook that checks each session in with the instance
